summary: Module 04 (zh) done: seven parts translated in parallel and checked one by one (code blocks byte-identical, section ids and containers equal), then terms aligned across parts: lag as 滞后 (delay stays 延迟), annotation as 注释向量, Duffing 振子, 重新居中. check.mjs --module 4: 0 errors, 0 warnings for both languages and their parity (sections 25, labs 5, exercises 15, quiz 12, papers 3, figures 16, widgets 2, maths 1,946, code 51, outputs 40). The Chinese page renders with local KaTeX with no KaTeX errors, no unrendered maths, both widgets loading without script errors, no broken images and no literal asterisks; the 16 Chinese figures were screenshotted and read correctly.
issues: The translators shared a scratch directory and overwrote each other's draft files (p1.md, p2.md); each rebuilt from uniquely named files, and the per-part parity check plus a section-id comparison confirm that every part holds only its own sections. Future runs should give each translator its own scratch folder.
